problem_statement: When a Multicast-DNS responder receives a query with the Query-unicast (QU) flag and then is sent the same QU query again, it should rate-limit the unicast response (emitting nothing within the minimum interval) and, when that interval has elapsed, fall through to a multicast response so other queriers on the network still receive the answer. The current behavior does not rate-limit unicast (QU) responses the way it rate-limits multicast responses, so repeated QU queries produce repeated unicast answers instead of being suppressed or converted to a multicast response.
